abstract: This study examines whether Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests to the Securities and Exchange Commission convey value-relevant information about publicly traded firms and whether sophisticated investors trade on that information. Our empirical analysis reveals heterogeneous value relevance associated with different types of requests. Specifically, requests submitted by proxy agents to probe for ongoing investigations as well as anonymous requests are negatively correlated with future returns, while requests from institutional investors and intellectual property entities are associated with positive future returns. Our results also support the direct-trading hypothesis, showing institutional investors and short sellers trade on FOIA-obtained information. Our findings add to the information-acquisition literature by highlighting the heterogeneous value signals in FOIA requests, particularly the negative value signals.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了向证券交易委员会提交的《信息自由法》（FOIA）请求是否传递了关于上市公司价值相关的信息，以及成熟投资者是否利用这些信息进行交易。我们的实证分析揭示了不同类型请求所关联的价值相关性存在异质性。具体而言，由代理机构提交以探查正在进行的调查的请求以及匿名请求与未来回报呈负相关，而来自机构投资者和知识产权实体的请求则与正向未来回报相关联。我们的结果也支持直接交易假说，表明机构投资者和卖空者基于通过FOIA获取的信息进行交易。我们的发现通过强调FOIA请求中异质性的价值信号，尤其是负面价值信号，为信息获取文献做出了贡献。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The information content of private information acquisition: evidence from FOIA requests to the SEC
title_zh: 私有信息获取的信息含量：来自向SEC提交FOIA请求的证据

abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodology for analyzing anomalies in conditional asset pricing models with time-varying risk exposures and premia. Our approach extends the conventional two-pass methodology to include both ordinary and weighted least-squares estimation in a conditional setting. We establish closed-form standard errors to statistically dissect anomalies, including a version robust to global misspecification. We introduce a novel R 2 criterion to quantify the joint contribution of large anomaly sets in explaining cross-sectional stock return variations. Our analysis highlights the significant impact of anomalies during economic and financial crises, linking them closely with market conditions. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: This project has received funding from the postdoctoral fellowships programme Beatriu de Pinos, funded by the Secretary of Universities and Research (Government of Catalonia) and by the Horizon 2020 programme of research and innovation of the European Union under the [Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968 .
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于分析具有时变风险暴露和溢价的条件资产定价模型中的异常现象。我们的方法将传统的两阶段方法论扩展至条件环境下的普通最小二乘与加权最小二乘估计。我们建立了闭式标准误，以统计方式剖析异常现象，包括对全局误设具有稳健性的版本。我们引入了一个新颖的R²准则，用以量化大型异常集合在解释横截面股票收益变动中的联合贡献。我们的分析强调了异常在经济和金融危机期间的重要影响，将其与市场状况紧密联系起来。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。资助：本项目获得了Beatriu de Pinos博士后奖学金计划的资助，该计划由加泰罗尼亚政府大学与研究秘书处以及欧盟Horizon 2020研究与创新计划下的[Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]提供资金。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Dissecting Anomalies in Conditional Asset Pricing
title_zh: 分解条件资产定价中的异象

abstract: We study the equity factor zoo using a duration-matching return-decomposition approach that adjusts factor returns by subtracting returns on duration-matched government bond portfolios. By doing so, we remove the component of factor returns attributable to interest rate movements while preserving shocks to expected growth and risk premia observed in the data. Among commonly used factors, the value, investment, and profitability premia increase after duration matching, while the market and size premia decrease, over the post-1981 sample period. Furthermore, the effect of duration matching on mean factor returns depends importantly on the interest rate environment, consistent with our return decomposition framework. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851 .
abstract_zh: 我们采用期限匹配的收益分解方法研究股票因子动物园，该方法通过减去期限匹配的政府债券组合收益来调整因子收益。通过这一处理，我们剔除了因子收益中归因于利率变动的部分，同时保留了数据中观察到的预期增长与风险溢价冲击。在常用因子中，价值、投资和盈利溢价在期限匹配后有所增加，而市场与规模溢价在1981年后的样本期内则有所下降。此外，期限匹配对平均因子收益的影响在很大程度上取决于利率环境，这与我们的收益分解框架相一致。本文已被Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08851获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: The Factor Multiverse: The Role of Interest Rates in Factor Return Measurement
title_zh: 因子多元宇宙：利率在因子收益度量中的作用

abstract: The US Entity List policy, by severing access to critical intermediate inputs and technology transfers for specific Chinese enterprises, potentially exacerbates supply ‐ demand imbalance. Using panel data of Chinese listed enterprises from 2010 to 2023, this paper treats the imposition of Entity List sanctions on enterprises as a quasi‐natural experiment, with the aim of assessing the causal impact of these sanctions on enterprise capacity utilisation (CU). The empirical results indicate that: (1) The Entity List has led to a significant decline in the CU of Chinese enterprises; (2) The Entity List suppresses CU primarily by deteriorating enterprise performance and tightening financing constraints; (3) University‐industry collaboration and government subsidies serve as effective mitigating factors, significantly alleviating the negative impact of the Entity List on CU; (4) Heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that the negative impact is more pronounced for enterprises characterised by higher asset depreciation rates, weaker market competitiveness, greater centralised supplier concentration and those not deploying within the Belt and Road countries. These findings demonstrate that the US Entity List has driven China's structural contradictions to spread into high‐tech industries, no longer confined solely to traditional sectors such as steel and cement. Simultaneously, the results highlight the critical role of knowledge spillovers from domestic universities and strategic government support in helping enterprises withstand shocks like supply disruptions.
abstract_zh: 美国实体清单政策通过切断特定中国企业获取关键中间投入品和技术转让的渠道，可能加剧供需失衡。利用2010年至2023年中国上市企业面板数据，本文将企业遭受实体清单制裁视为准自然实验，旨在评估制裁对企业产能利用率的因果影响。实证结果表明：（1）实体清单导致中国企业产能利用率显著下降；（2）实体清单主要通过恶化企业绩效和收紧融资约束来抑制产能利用率；（3）产学研合作与政府补贴作为有效的缓解因素，显著减轻了实体清单对产能利用率的负面影响；（4）异质性分析显示，对于资产折旧率较高、市场竞争力较弱、供应商集中度较高以及未在“一带一路”国家布局的企业，负面影响更为显著。这些发现表明，美国实体清单已推动中国结构性矛盾向高科技产业蔓延，不再局限于钢铁、水泥等传统行业。同时，结果凸显了国内大学知识溢出和战略性政府支持在帮助企业抵御供应中断等冲击中的关键作用。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The Impact of US Export Controls on the Capacity Utilisation of Chinese Enterprises: An Empirical Study Based on the Entity List
title_zh: 美国出口管制对中国企业产能利用率的影响：基于实体清单的实证研究

abstract: Natural disasters increasingly threaten global food security, yet the resilience of mechanized, middle‐income agriculture remains a puzzle. Standard development theory suggests households manage shocks by substituting labor for capital. We show this mechanism fails in modern, mechanized agriculture because substituting labor for destroyed capital is infeasible in the short run. We estimate the impact of the February 2023 earthquakes in Turkiye on agricultural supply, separating extensive margin adjustments (cultivated land) from intensive margin effects (yields). This disaster represents a unique ‘dual shock’: physical capital destruction coincided with a liquidity crisis that blocked asset replacement. To analyse this, we adapt the Agricultural Household Model using a Leontief (fixed‐proportions) representation as a short‐run limiting case. Empirically, we employ a Synthetic Difference‐in‐Differences strategy, combining district‐level crop statistics with remote sensing data. We find a significant contraction at the extensive margin: wheat cultivation declined by 8.5% relative to the pre‐treatment mean in the 2024‐restricted specification. Yet, we identify a ‘Null Yield Effect’ at the intensive margin. Yields remained stable or increased. This aligns with ‘Ricardian Selection,’ where producers—facing binding capital constraints—abandon marginal lands to concentrate resources on prime plots; consistent with this mechanism, the yield gain is concentrated in marginal, low‐quality districts and absent where land is better. Sharp declines in new tractor registrations (24%) and agricultural credit (16.5%) confirm a ‘Scarcity Trap.’ In high‐inflation, mechanized environments, cash transfers are insufficient. Policy must instead prioritize in‐kind capital replacement to bypass liquidity constraints and restore capacity.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害日益威胁全球粮食安全，然而机械化、中等收入农业的韧性仍是一个未解之谜。标准发展理论认为，家庭通过以劳动力替代资本来应对冲击。我们证明，这一机制在现代机械化农业中失效，因为在短期内以劳动力替代被摧毁的资本并不可行。我们估算了2023年2月土耳其地震对农业供给的影响，将集约边际调整（耕地面积）与广延边际效应（单产）区分开来。此次灾害构成了一次独特的“双重冲击”：物质资本毁坏与流动性危机同时发生，后者阻碍了资产重置。为分析这一问题，我们采用Leontief（固定比例）生产函数作为短期极限情形，对农业家庭模型进行了适应性改造。在实证方面，我们采用合成双重差分策略，将区级作物统计数据与遥感数据相结合。我们发现广延边际出现显著收缩：在2024年限制性设定中，小麦种植面积较处理前均值下降8.5%。然而，我们在集约边际识别出“零单产效应”——单产保持稳定甚至有所上升。这与“李嘉图选择”相一致，即面临资本约束的生产者放弃边际土地，将资源集中于优质地块；与该机制一致的是，单产增益集中在边际、低质量地区，而在土地质量较好的地区则不存在。新拖拉机注册量（下降24%）和农业信贷（下降16.5%）的急剧减少证实了“稀缺陷阱”的存在。在高通胀、机械化的环境中，现金转移支付不足以解决问题。政策应优先采取实物资本重置的方式，以绕过流动性约束并恢复生产能力。
title: Mechanized Fragility in Turkish Agriculture: Earthquakes, Capital Destruction and the Scarcity Trap
title_zh: 土耳其农业的机械化脆弱性：地震、资本破坏与稀缺陷阱

abstract: Financial history is plagued by a visibility trap. Using the Brussels Stock Exchange (1850–1913), we demonstrate that asset illiquidity introduced selection bias, which systematically inflated historical risk premia. Applying a latent return model, we argue that correcting for this illiquidity decreases the equity and corporate bond risk premia and collapses the risk–return relationship. We show that the assets that were more exposed to selection bias underperformed in subsequent months. We identify two institutional drivers of this phenomenon: censored price lists curated by the financial media and the exchange's policy to cease publishing bids and ask quotes in its official price lists from 1889 onwards.
abstract_zh: 金融历史深受一种“可见性陷阱”的困扰。利用布鲁塞尔证券交易所（1850-1913年）的数据，我们证明资产流动性不足引入了选择偏差，这系统性地抬高了历史风险溢价。通过应用潜在收益模型，我们认为纠正这一流动性不足会降低股票和公司债券的风险溢价，并使风险-收益关系趋于消失。我们显示，那些更易受选择偏差影响的资产在随后几个月中表现不佳。我们识别出这一现象的两个制度性驱动因素：金融媒体策划的删减价格列表，以及交易所自1889年起停止在其官方价格列表中公布买卖报价的政策。
title: Risk premia reconsidered: Illiquidity and selection bias for stocks and corporate bonds in the pre‐First World War period
title_zh: 风险溢价再探讨：第一次世界大战前股票与公司债券的流动性不足与选择偏差

abstract: We study the effects of consumers' unsystematic perception mistakes on market outcomes and consumer welfare. In the model, two firms produce goods of different quality and compete by choosing prices. Consumers observe the qualities and/or the prices with noise and make choice mistakes as a result. When the magnitude of mistakes grows, the lower‐quality firm increases its price while the higher‐quality firm initially reduces its price before increasing it. We show that this price reduction effect is so strong that consumers eventually benefit from making a small amount of unsystematic mistakes despite the sub‐optimal choices and the increasing price of the lower‐quality firm.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了消费者非系统性感知错误对市场结果和消费者福利的影响。在模型中，两家企业生产不同质量的商品，并通过选择价格进行竞争。消费者在观察质量和/或价格时存在噪声，从而导致选择错误。当错误幅度增大时，低质量企业提高其价格，而高质量企业则先降低价格后再提高。我们表明，这种降价效应如此显著，以至于消费者最终会因犯少量非系统性错误而受益，尽管存在次优选择及低质量企业价格上涨的情况。
title: Good Unsystematic Mistakes
title_zh: 良好的非系统性错误

abstract: We develop an axiomatic framework for evaluating interval policy platforms. Rather than treating an interval platform as a noisy point estimate, we interpret it as a commitment set and study how voters rank such sets under geometric invariances, valence monotonicity, and continuity. Our first result is an ordinal dimensional reduction: at any fixed valence level, preferences over interval platforms are order-equivalent to preferences over a single scalar index that aggregates distance and width (the Canonical Reduction (CR) index). We then add valence-shift invariance and obtain a valence-minus-penalty representation: voters behave as if utility increases with valence and decreases with a monotone transform of the CR-index. This representation yields empirically refutable restrictions on distance–width trade-offs while remaining agnostic about probabilistic microfoundations. To illustrate, we embed it in a Downsian environment with reduced-form precision costs and show how, in a symmetric benchmark, electoral competition separates into location and width choices. The framework therefore provides a tractable benchmark for analyzing strategic imprecision in electoral competition and related social-science settings.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个公理化框架，用以评估区间政策平台。不同于将区间平台视为带噪声的点估计，我们将其解释为承诺集合，并研究选民在几何不变性、效价单调性和连续性条件下如何对这些集合进行排序。我们的首个结果是序数维度缩减：在任一固定效价水平下，对区间平台的偏好与对单一标量指数的偏好序等价，该指数综合了距离与宽度（即规范缩减（CR）指数）。随后，我们引入效价平移不变性，得到效价减去惩罚的表示形式：选民的行为表现为效用随效价增加而增加，并随CR指数的单调变换而减少。该表示形式对距离-宽度权衡施加了可经验反驳的约束，同时保持对概率微观基础的中立态度。为加以说明，我们将其嵌入一个具有简化形式精度成本的唐斯式环境中，并展示在对称基准情形下，选举竞争如何分解为位置与宽度的选择。因此，该框架为分析选举竞争及相关社会科学情境中的策略性模糊性提供了一个易于处理的基准。
title: Voter preferences over interval platforms: Axioms, canonical reduction, and valence-minus-penalty representation
title_zh: 区间平台上的选民偏好：公理、规范约简与价值减惩罚表示

abstract: African agricultural systems are at a critical juncture, grappling with the interconnected challenges of soil degradation, climate change vulnerability, and rising food insecurity. While innovative, context-appropriate technologies are urgently needed, a significant chasm often separates promising pilot-scale demonstrations from their widespread adoption within national agricultural frameworks. This perspective paper explores biochar, a carbon-dense substance generated from the pyrolysis of organic waste, as a significant case study of this pilot-to-policy divide. Building upon recent discussions that have highlighted its potential, this analysis moves beyond advocacy to provide a critical examination of the socio-technical and economic barriers impeding its integration into African farming systems. We synthesize evidence from ongoing initiatives across the continent to argue that biochar's agronomic and climate benefits, while well-documented in experimental settings, remain unrealized at scale due to policy misalignment, limited farmer awareness, and underdeveloped value chains. We advocate for a unified approach to integrating biochar, underscoring the necessity for its official incorporation in national climate commitments, the tactical realignment of agricultural incentives, the establishment of continent-wide quality benchmarks, and its expedited assimilation into carbon market frameworks. We conclude that without such systemic and policy-oriented support, biochar and other similarly promising agricultural innovations risk remaining perpetually in a pilot phase, thereby delaying crucial progress toward a more resilient and food-secure future for the continent.
abstract_zh: 非洲农业系统正处于关键转折点，面临土壤退化、气候变化脆弱性和日益加剧的粮食不安全等多重相互关联的挑战。尽管迫切需要创新且符合当地实际情况的技术，但前景广阔的试点规模示范与其在国家农业框架内的广泛采用之间，往往存在显著鸿沟。本文以视角论文的形式，探讨生物炭——一种通过有机废弃物热解产生的富碳物质——作为这一从试点到政策鸿沟的重要案例研究。在近期讨论凸显其潜力的基础上，本分析超越单纯倡导，对阻碍其融入非洲农业系统的社会技术及经济障碍进行批判性审视。我们综合非洲大陆正在进行的相关举措的证据，论证生物炭在农艺和气候方面的效益虽在实验环境中得到充分记录，但由于政策错位、农民认知有限以及价值链发展不足，其在大规模应用中仍未得到实现。我们倡导采用统一方法整合生物炭，强调将其正式纳入国家气候承诺、对农业激励措施进行战略性调整、建立全大陆质量标准，以及加速其融入碳市场框架的必要性。我们得出结论，若无此类系统性和政策导向的支持，生物炭及其他同样前景广阔的农业创新可能永远停留在试点阶段，从而延误非洲大陆迈向更具韧性和粮食安全未来的关键进展。
title: From waste to resilience: A circular biochar framework for climate-smart agriculture in Africa
title_zh: 从废弃物到韧性：非洲气候智慧农业的循环生物炭框架

abstract: Brownfield regeneration is increasingly central to sustainable land-use policy in Europe, as it supports soil protection, compact urban development, urban restructuring, and reduced pressure on greenfield land. Yet redevelopment remains difficult because contaminated land is shaped not only by market conditions, but also by the institutional design of planning, remediation, financing, and intergovernmental coordination. This article compares Spain and the Netherlands to examine how different land-use policy architectures condition brownfield regeneration. Using a qualitative comparative approach that combines doctrinal legal analysis with institutional interpretation, it analyzes four dimensions: risk allocation, planning–environment integration, value-capture mechanisms, and governance modes. The findings identify two contrasting models. Spain operates through a codified and redistributive framework in which liability and value capture are largely predefined by statute, while remediation and planning remain institutionally differentiated. The Netherlands exhibits a more integrated and adaptive model in which environmental regulation is more closely embedded within spatial planning and redevelopment relies more heavily on negotiated coordination and local administrative capacity. The comparison shows that legislative integration alone does not ensure effective regeneration. What matters more is the alignment between liability rules, financial design, and governance capacity. The article concludes that brownfield redevelopment should be understood as a land-use policy problem of institutional coordination, not merely as a technical question of remediation or a market question of land valorization.
abstract_zh: 棕地再开发正日益成为欧洲可持续土地利用政策的核心议题，因为它有助于土壤保护、紧凑型城市发展、城市更新以及减轻对绿地的开发压力。然而，由于受污染土地不仅受市场条件影响，还受规划、修复、融资和政府间协调的制度设计制约，再开发仍然面临困难。本文通过比较西班牙与荷兰，考察不同的土地利用政策架构如何影响棕地再开发。采用结合法律条文分析与制度解释的定性比较方法，本文从四个维度展开分析：风险分配、规划与环境整合、价值捕获机制以及治理模式。研究发现存在两种截然不同的模式。西班牙运行于一个法典化且具有再分配性质的框架之中，其中责任归属和价值捕获在很大程度上由法律预先设定，而修复与规划在制度上保持分离。荷兰则展现出一种更为整合且适应性更强的模式，其环境规制更紧密地嵌入空间规划之中，再开发更依赖于协商协调和地方行政能力。比较结果表明，仅靠立法整合并不能确保有效的再开发。更为关键的是责任规则、财务设计与治理能力之间的匹配。本文得出结论：棕地再开发应被理解为一项涉及制度协调的土地利用政策问题，而不仅仅是修复的技术问题或土地增值的市场问题。
title: Land-use policy architectures for brownfield regeneration: A comparative analysis of Spain and the Netherlands
title_zh: 棕地再开发的土地利用政策架构：西班牙与荷兰的比较分析

abstract: We study how monetary policy shapes macroeconomic outcomes in a two-sector small open economy hit by export shocks —due, e.g., to export tariffs, geopolitical tensions, or a recession in destination countries— allowing the shock to have both aggregate and distributional effects. Imperfect worker mobility across sectors, coupled with incomplete markets against aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks, implies that export contractions (i) spill over across sectors due to households’ precautionary response and (ii) affect income and consumption inequalities within and across sectors —in addition to their usual asymmetric effects on sectoral outputs and wages. In this context, exchange-rate flexibility provides insurance against inefficient fluctuations in consumption inequality, which increases the social value of floating-rate regimes. Relative to a nominal exchange-rate peg, flexible inflation targeting helps mitigate the rise in consumption inequality after an export contraction, especially among tradable-sector workers. However, even flexible inflation targeting does not in general provide sufficient exchange-rate flexibility relative to the optimal monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究货币政策如何在遭受出口冲击（例如，因出口关税、地缘政治紧张局势或目的地国经济衰退所致）的二元部门小型开放经济中塑造宏观经济结果，并允许该冲击同时具有总量效应和分配效应。部门间工人流动性不完善，加之针对总量冲击和异质性冲击的市场不完全性，意味着出口收缩（i）因家庭预防性反应而跨部门溢出，且（ii）除对部门产出和工资产生通常的非对称影响外，还影响部门内及部门间的收入与消费不平等。在此背景下，汇率灵活性为消费不平等的低效波动提供了保险，从而提升了浮动汇率制度的社会价值。相对于名义汇率钉住制度，灵活的通胀目标制有助于缓解出口收缩后消费不平等的加剧，尤其是在可贸易部门工人中。然而，即便采用灵活的通胀目标制，相对于最优货币政策而言，通常也无法提供足够的汇率灵活性。
title: Monetary stabilization of export shocks, revisited
title_zh: 出口冲击的货币稳定化：再探讨

abstract: Targeted educational interventions for primary school children in low-income countries have led to substantial improvements in learning, but their impact varies considerably across studies, raising questions about how to sustain their effectiveness in different settings. In this paper, we study a novel primary education program that combines a conventional in-school targeted pedagogical intervention with an out-of-school study group initiative facilitated by the community. To identify the impact of the program and its components, we design a cross-cutting randomized experiment across 200 villages in Assam, India. Our results show that standalone implementation of either component has no significant effect on learning outcomes, but when the components are combined in the full program, they improve children’s test scores in mathematics and language by 0.11 and 0.09 standard deviations, respectively. Our results suggest that integrating in-school targeted instruction with community-based out-of-school activities can enhance program effectiveness by increasing students’ engagement and overall exposure to learning, at relatively low cost.
abstract_zh: 针对低收入国家小学生的定向教育干预措施已显著提升学习成效，但不同研究间效果差异显著，引发关于如何在不同环境中维持其有效性的疑问。本文研究了一项新颖的小学教育项目，该项目将传统的校内定向教学干预与社区推动的校外学习小组活动相结合。为识别该项目及其组成部分的影响，我们在印度阿萨姆邦的200个村庄设计了一项交叉随机实验。结果显示，单独实施任一组成部分对学习成果均无显著影响，但当这些组成部分整合于完整项目中时，分别使儿童数学和语言测试成绩提高了0.11和0.09个标准差。我们的研究结果表明，将校内定向教学与基于社区的校外活动相结合，能通过增加学生参与度和整体学习接触时间，以相对较低的成本提升项目有效性。
title: Supporting learning in and out of school: Experimental evidence from India
title_zh: 支持校内外的学习：来自印度的实验证据

abstract: We examine how drug-related violence influences emigration choices in Central America, a region that has experienced a sharp increase in migration to the United States. Combining multiple data sources, we leverage an instrumental variables strategy that exploits local variation in proximity to drug-trafficking routes and coca production in Colombia. Our results show that rising violence increases intentions, plans, and preparations to emigrate, particularly to the United States. These migration responses are strongest among young and higher-skilled individuals. Mediation analysis suggests that these migration responses operate predominantly through declining economic activity and worsening labor-market conditions in Central America, rather than through a direct response to insecurity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了毒品相关暴力如何影响中美洲地区的移民选择，该地区向美国的移民数量急剧增加。结合多种数据来源，我们采用工具变量策略，利用靠近毒品贩运路线及哥伦比亚古柯生产的局部差异。研究结果显示，暴力升级增加了移民的意向、计划及准备，尤其是前往美国的移民。这些移民反应在年轻及高技能人群中最为显著。中介分析表明，这些移民反应主要通过中美洲经济活动衰退和劳动力市场状况恶化发挥作用，而非直接源于对不安全感的回应。
title: Is drug-related violence fueling emigration from Central America?
title_zh: 毒品相关暴力是否加剧了中美洲的移民外流？

abstract: This paper assesses the role of climate policies as a catalyst of low carbon technologies deployment through foreign direct investment (FDI). Leveraging detailed cross-border project-level information, it identifies “green” FDI and finds that a higher number of active climate policies is associated with higher levels of green FDI inflows. Importantly, climate policies do not appear to be linked to lower levels of non-green projects, suggesting relatively small overall costs from the green transition. The paper also finds heterogeneity across sectors and policy instruments. The association between climate policies and green projects is particularly strong in energy and manufacturing, and when the composition of the recipient's climate portfolio is tilted towards binding policies (e.g., taxes and regulation) and expenditure measures. Finally, results point to policy spillovers, whereby larger climate policy portfolios in the source country are linked to higher green FDI outflows, but green subsidies can discourage them. This, in turn, implies that subsidies could hamper efforts to deploy low-carbon technologies across countries.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候政策作为催化剂，通过外国直接投资（FDI）促进低碳技术部署的作用。利用详细的跨境项目级信息，识别出“绿色”FDI，并发现活跃气候政策数量越多，绿色FDI流入量越高。重要的是，气候政策与非绿色FDI流入的减少并无关联。本文还发现不同部门和政策工具之间存在异质性。气候政策与绿色项目之间的关联在能源和制造业领域更为显著，且当接收国的气候政策组合偏向于约束性政策（税收和法规）及支出措施时，这种关联更强。最后，结果揭示了政策溢出效应，即来源国更庞大的气候政策组合与更高的绿色FDI流出相关联。此外，来源国更庞大的气候政策组合能放大目的地国气候政策作为绿色FDI催化剂的角色。
title: Climate policies as a catalyst for green FDI
title_zh: 气候政策作为绿色外商直接投资的催化剂

abstract: The recent decades have witnessed a remarkable surge in machinery imports from China to African economies. Our study examines the causes and local implications of these imports. Notably, we find that China’s efforts to decommission excess capacity have been a driving force behind this trend. Chinese city industries that face urgent capacity elimination requirements imposed by the government tend to export machinery equipment to emerging markets, particularly African countries with weaker environmental regulations and abundant resources. By using instrumental variables based on China’s annual lists of eliminated capacity, we find mixed effects of machinery imports on African economies. They increase output and value added in recipient industries that use the imported machinery, but have limited effects on employment and intersectoral linkages. Nevertheless, labor markets in affected regions reallocate away from agriculture toward both high-skilled and low-skilled occupations. These regions also experience higher pollution levels and increased nighttime light intensity.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，非洲经济体从中国进口机械设备的数量显著激增。本研究探讨了这些进口的成因及其对当地的影响。值得注意的是，我们发现中国淘汰过剩产能的努力是推动这一趋势的关键因素。面临政府紧迫产能淘汰要求的中国城市产业，倾向于向新兴市场出口机械设备，尤其是那些环境规制较弱且资源丰富的非洲国家。通过利用基于中国年度淘汰产能清单的工具变量，我们发现机械设备进口对非洲经济体的影响喜忧参半。这些进口提升了使用进口机械的接收行业的产出和附加值，但对就业和跨部门关联的影响有限。尽管如此，受影响地区的劳动力市场从农业向高技能和低技能职业重新配置。这些地区还经历了更高的污染水平和夜间灯光强度的增加。

title: Tapping into excess capacity: Chinese machinery exports and African industrialization
title_zh: 释放过剩产能：中国机械出口与非洲工业化

abstract: This paper examines a novel channel through which trade agreements affect product quality upgrading. Specifically, we analyze the impact of the US granting Permanent Normal Trade Relations (PNTR) status to China—a policy shift that effectively eliminated trade policy uncertainty (TPU) on imports from China. Using a triple-difference estimation strategy, we find that eliminating TPU encourages Chinese incumbent exporters to improve product quality. This quality-enhancing effect is particularly pronounced among low-productivity firms, firms in industries with high sunk costs, and firms located in regions with favorable market conditions. Quality upgrading by incumbents drives aggregate quality improvement, and ignoring this adjustment would underestimate the benefits for US consumers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了贸易协定影响产品质量升级的一个新渠道。具体而言，我们分析了美国给予中国永久正常贸易关系（PNTR）地位——这一政策变化实质上消除了对中国进口的贸易政策不确定性（TPU）——所产生的影响。运用三重差分估计策略，我们发现消除贸易政策不确定性会激励中国在位出口商提升产品质量。这一质量提升效应在低生产率企业、高沉没成本行业中的企业以及位于市场条件有利地区的企业中尤为显著。在位企业的质量升级推动了整体质量的提升，而忽视这一调整将低估美国消费者所获得的福利。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Sailing in calmer waters: Trade policy uncertainty and product quality
title_zh: 在平静水域航行：贸易政策不确定性与产品质量

abstract: How did #MeToo alter collaboration between women and men? I show junior female researchers start fewer projects after #MeToo. A decrease in collaborations with male coauthors—especially new senior male coauthors at the same institution—largely explains the decline. The decrease is larger at universities with higher perceived harassment accusation risk and smaller where both women and men publicly express greater awareness of gender issues. I find no evidence that reduced collaboration improves research outcomes for junior female researchers. The results suggest that #MeToo led to a breakdown in trust that came at a cost for junior women's career opportunities.
abstract_zh: #MeToo如何改变了女性与男性之间的合作？我展示了在#MeToo之后，初级女性研究员开始的项目数量减少。与男性合著者——尤其是同一机构内新晋资深男性合著者——合作的减少在很大程度上解释了这一下降趋势。在感知到骚扰指控风险较高的大学，下降幅度更大；而在女性和男性都公开表达出更高性别问题意识的大学，下降幅度则较小。我没有发现证据表明合作减少能改善初级女性研究员的研究成果。结果表明，#MeToo导致了信任的破裂，这对初级女性的职业机会造成了代价。
title: The Unintended Consequences of #MeToo: Evidence from Research Collaborations in Economics and Finance
title_zh: #MeToo的意外后果：来自经济学与金融学研究合作的证据

abstract: The increasing integration of agricultural commodity markets and growing external uncertainty have made risk transmission along China’s hog–feed supply chain an important issue for agricultural risk management. This study investigates the tail-risk spillovers between China’s live hog futures and five major feed futures (No. 1 soybean, No. 2 soybean, soybean meal, soybean oil, and corn) using daily data from January 2021 to July 2025. The quantile Granger causality test, the Multivariate Multiple-Quantile Conditional Autoregressive Value at Risk (MVMQ-CAViaR) model, and quantile impulse response analysis are employed to examine cross-market dependence under extreme market conditions. The results show that significant tail dependence exists between live hog and feed futures, with spillover patterns varying across commodities and quantiles. The MVMQ-CAViaR estimates reveal heterogeneous and state-dependent cross-market interactions. Subsample analysis indicates that the Russia–Ukraine conflict altered the pattern of tail-risk transmission rather than uniformly strengthening spillovers across markets. Quantile impulse responses further show that feed-market shocks generate short-run responses that gradually converge to equilibrium. These findings provide new evidence on tail-risk transmission within China’s hog–feed futures system and offer implications for agricultural risk management and futures market regulation. KEYWORDS: Live hog futures feed commodity futures hog industry chain extreme risk spillovers JEL CLASSIFICATION: G13 Q11
abstract_zh: 农业商品市场一体化程度的提高和外部不确定性的加剧，使得中国生猪—饲料供应链中的风险传导成为农业风险管理的重要议题。本研究利用2021年1月至2025年7月的日度数据，考察中国生猪活体期货与五种主要饲料期货（一号大豆、二号大豆、豆粕、豆油和玉米）之间的尾部风险溢出效应。采用分位数格兰杰因果检验、多元多分位数条件自回归风险价值（MVMQ-CAViaR）模型以及分位数脉冲响应分析，研究极端市场条件下的跨市场依赖性。结果表明，生猪活体期货与饲料期货之间存在显著的尾部依赖关系，且溢出模式因商品和分位数的不同而存在差异。MVMQ-CAViaR估计揭示了异质性和状态依赖性的跨市场交互作用。子样本分析表明，俄乌冲突改变了尾部风险传导的模式，而非在各市场间一致性地增强溢出效应。分位数脉冲响应进一步显示，饲料市场冲击产生的短期响应会逐渐收敛至均衡状态。这些发现为中国生猪—饲料期货体系内的尾部风险传导提供了新的证据，并对农业风险管理和期货市场监管具有启示意义。关键词：生猪活体期货 饲料商品期货 生猪产业链 极端风险溢出 JEL分类号：G13 Q11

title: Extreme risk spillovers between live hog and feed ingredient futures in China

abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies.
abstract_zh: 我们将两大全球趋势——人工智能与地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响人工智能的国际扩散、收益规模及其在各经济体间的分布。我们不仅从一般层面提出这些问题，还特别聚焦于中东、北非及巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦AI与地缘经济碎片化对全球及中东北非经济体的影响，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，作者姓名不足以判定为中国研究。
title: AI in a Fragmenting World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI

abstract: This paper studies how an unemployment-benefit reform in one member state of a monetary union affects savings, net foreign asset positions, and fiscal space across member states when households face incomplete insurance. Lower benefits reduce unemployment and increase fiscal space in the reforming country. Employed workers increase their precautionary savings to compensate for reduced public insurance. A portion of these savings is invested abroad, pushing the non-reforming country into a negative net foreign asset position and lowering its long-run consumption. Despite raising fiscal space and long-run average consumption in the reforming country, the reform may decrease ex-ante welfare because it reduces insurance and depresses consumption during the transition as households self-insure through higher savings. We discipline our proposed model with firm-level evidence on Germany’s post-reform tradable-sector expansion following the Hartz IV reform of unemployment benefits. In our simulation, this reform accounts for a substantial share of the observed post-reform open-economy adjustment, whereas the earlier wage moderation cannot explain most of the observed patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在一个货币联盟中，某一成员国的失业救济改革如何影响各成员国的储蓄、净外国资产头寸及财政空间，前提是家庭面临不完全保险。降低救济金减少了改革国的失业并扩大了其财政空间。就业工人增加预防性储蓄以弥补公共保险的减少。这部分储蓄的一部分投资于国外，使非改革国陷入负净外国资产头寸，并降低其长期消费。尽管改革提高了改革国的财政空间和长期平均消费，但由于减少了保险并在转型期间因家庭通过更高储蓄进行自我保险而抑制了消费，改革可能降低事前福利。我们利用德国哈茨四号失业救济改革后贸易部门扩张的企业层面证据来校准所提出的模型。在我们的模拟中，这项改革解释了观察到的改革后开放经济调整的相当大份额，而早前的工资节制则无法解释大部分观察到的模式。
title: Incomplete Insurance and Open-Economy Spillovers of Labor Market Reforms
title_zh: 不完全保险与劳动力市场改革的开放经济溢出效应

abstract: The choice of a major in higher education is closely associated with the sector of activity of future employment. As a labour price signal, the industry salary level is transmitted to candidates through the labour market and affects their choice of major. Drawing on panel data matching college entrance examination admission scores of majors with industry salary levels from 147 Chinese ‘Double First-Class’ universities during 2019–2023, this study employs fixed-effects panel regression models to explore the mechanism underlying the effect of industry salary levels on college entrance examination admission scores for corresponding majors. The findings indicate that rising industry salary levels significantly increase the college entrance examination admission scores of relevant majors, and that the rising popularity of majors and the improvement in teaching quality are important factors contributing to these higher admission scores. More importantly, the increasing salary levels of upstream industries also contribute to higher college entrance examination admission scores for majors related to the target industry. From the perspective of salary signals, this article provides empirical evidence regarding the major choices of college entrance examination candidates, the structure of university majors, and the improvement of the talent supply–demand matching mechanism. KEYWORDS: Industry salary level price signal college entrance examination score for majors Double First-Class universities JEL CLASSIFICATION: J31 J24 I21
abstract_zh: 高等教育专业选择与未来就业的行业领域密切相关。作为劳动力价格信号，行业薪酬水平通过劳动力市场传递给考生，并影响其专业选择。本研究利用2019—2023年间147所中国“双一流”高校的专业高考录取分数与行业薪酬水平相匹配的面板数据，采用固定效应面板回归模型，探讨行业薪酬水平对相应专业高考录取分数的影响机制。研究结果表明，行业薪酬水平的上升显著提高了相关专业的高考录取分数，而专业热度的上升及教学质量的提升是推动录取分数提高的重要因素。更为重要的是，上游行业薪酬水平的提升同样有助于提高目标行业相关专业的高考录取分数。本文从薪酬信号视角，为高考考生的专业选择、高校专业结构设置及人才供需匹配机制的完善提供了经验证据。关键词：行业薪酬水平；价格信号；专业高考录取分数；双一流高校 JEL分类：J31 J24 I21

title: Industry salary signals and adjustments in college entrance examination admission scores for majors: evidence from China’s Double First-Class universities
title_zh: 行业薪酬信号与高考专业录取分数线的调整：来自中国“双一流”大学的证据

abstract: This study examines the impact of smartphone adoption on livestock trading in pastoral China. We develop a bargaining and search model with two mechanisms: information discovery, which reduces herders’ search costs, and information posting, which expands market access. Using household survey data, we find that smartphone adoption increases selling prices. Mechanism analysis shows that traditional phone functions improve information access, while smartphone-specific features, especially information posting, enhance bargaining power by expanding selling channels and trader access. These findings demonstrate that digital technologies affect market outcomes not only through improved information access but also by reshaping bargaining structures and market participation.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了智能手机采用对中国牧区牲畜交易的影响。我们构建了一个包含两种机制的议价与搜索模型：信息发现机制，降低了牧民的搜索成本；信息发布机制，扩大了市场准入。利用家户调查数据，我们发现智能手机的采用提高了销售价格。机制分析表明，传统电话功能改善了信息获取，而智能手机特有功能，尤其是信息发布，通过拓宽销售渠道和增加交易商接触，增强了议价能力。这些发现表明，数字技术不仅通过改善信息获取，还通过重塑议价结构和市场参与，影响市场结果。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Smartphones, information, and bargaining power: Evidence from pastoral areas in China
title_zh: 智能手机、信息与议价能力：来自中国牧区的证据

abstract: Can localized weather shocks to upstream fuel suppliers undermine down-stream electricity reliability? Using administrative data linking South African power plants to contracted coal mines from 2015 to 2024, we combine plant operating records, mining-firm revenue data, and route-level traffic sensor data. Exploiting within-plant variation in supplier-mine rainfall, we find that rainfall shocks reduce mine output and lower coal plant availability. Daily traffic data confirm that rainfall reduces coal deliveries along contracted mine-to-plant routes. These disruptions propagate to the grid, contributing to rolling blackouts. Electricity security hinges on the resilience of coal supplyn contracts and logistics, not only on plant resilience.
abstract_zh: 局部天气冲击是否会通过上游燃料供应商传导至下游电力可靠性？利用2015至2024年间连接南非电厂与签约煤矿的行政数据，我们整合了电厂运行记录、矿业公司收入数据及路线级交通传感器数据。通过利用电厂内部供应商煤矿降雨量的变异，我们发现降雨冲击降低了煤矿产出，并减少了燃煤电厂的可用性。每日交通数据证实，降雨减少了签约煤矿至电厂路线的煤炭交付量。这些中断向电网传播，加剧了轮流停电现象。电力安全不仅取决于电厂自身的韧性，还依赖于煤炭供应合同及物流的恢复能力。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为南非电厂与煤矿，数据与制度背景均非中国，明确不涉及中国研究。
title: Coal Supply Chains and Electricity Reliability
title_zh: 煤炭供应链与电力可靠性

abstract: Fertility has fallen in nearly all high-income countries. People also report wanting fewer children: between 2012 and 2022 the ideal number of children fell from 2.42 to 2.31 and the share of respondents intending a child within three years fell from 28 to 21 percent over a similar period. Why? Using two cross-national surveys that ask respondents about their attitudes and their fertility preferences, both fielded twice roughly a decade apart, we decompose each decline into the contribution of a broad and competing set of attitudes. Three stand out: children are increasingly seen as interfering with the freedom of parents; views on whether mothers of young children should work have become markedly more progressive and account for a substantially larger share of the decline among the tertiary-educated; and fewer people believe that women or men need children to lead a fulfilled life. This last attitude changed most over the decade and is the largest contributor to the fall in intended fertility, above all among less-educated women. The changing division of household work and increasing work-family conflict have minor contributions to changing fertility preferences.
abstract_zh: 几乎所有高收入国家的生育率均有所下降。人们也报告称希望生育更少的孩子：从2012年到2022年，理想子女数从2.42降至2.31，而在相近时期内，表示三年内有意生育孩子的受访者比例从28%降至21%。原因何在？利用两项跨国调查，这些调查询问受访者的态度和生育偏好，且每项调查均相隔约十年进行了两次，我们将每次下降分解为一系列广泛且相互竞争的态度所贡献的部分。其中三项态度尤为突出：孩子日益被视为妨碍父母自由；对于年幼孩子的母亲是否应工作的看法显著趋于进步，且在高等教育程度群体中，这一态度对下降的贡献占比明显更大；以及越来越少的人认为，无论男女，都需要孩子才能过上充实的生活。最后一种态度在十年间变化最大，并且是导致预期生育率下降的最大因素，尤其是在教育程度较低的女性中。家务分工的变化以及工作与家庭冲突的加剧，对生育偏好变化的影响较小。
title: Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family
title_zh: 生育率下降：自由、成就与家庭价值的变迁

abstract: Social norms are an important barrier to gender convergence in economic outcomes. We study whether a public policy designed to promote gender equality at home can pave the way towards gender convergence by shaping gender norms in the next generation. We exploit the introduction of paid paternity leave in Spain in 2007, which granted fathers 13 days of non-transferable paid leave after childbirth. Eligibility depended sharply on the child’s date of birth. We combine this policy variation with original survey data collected from adolescents and implement a within-school difference-in-differences design comparing children born just before and after the reform cutoff within the same school cohort, using adjacent cohorts as controls. Children exposed to paternity leave eligibility display more egalitarian gender attitudes and beliefs in early adolescence. They are also more likely to engage in counter-stereotypical household chores, and hold less gender-stereotypical expectations regarding future work and family roles. The effects largely disappear in late adolescence.
abstract_zh: 社会规范是阻碍经济成果性别趋同的重要障碍。我们研究旨在促进家庭内部性别平等的公共政策，是否能够通过塑造下一代的性别规范，为性别趋同铺平道路。我们利用西班牙2007年引入的带薪陪产假政策，该政策赋予父亲在孩子出生后13天不可转让的带薪假期。资格严格取决于孩子的出生日期。我们将这一政策变化与从青少年中收集的原始调查数据相结合，实施校内双重差分设计，比较同一学校队列中在改革截止日期前后出生的儿童，并以相邻队列作为对照组。暴露于陪产假资格下的儿童在青春期早期表现出更平等的性别态度和信念。他们也更可能参与反刻板印象的家务劳动，并对未来的工作和家庭角色持有较少的性别刻板印象预期。这些影响在青春期后期基本消失。
title: Changing Gender Norms across Generations: Evidence from a Paternity Leave Reform
title_zh: 代际间性别规范的变迁：来自陪产假改革的证据

abstract: We study how subjective survival beliefs and financial literacy jointly shape saving and portfolio decisions later in life. Using data from the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing, we document that individuals who underestimate their survival probabilities are less likely to participate in risky financial markets. To identify the underlying mechanisms, we conduct a randomized survey experiment that cross-randomizes survival and financial literacy interventions and independently randomizes participation costs. Survival literacy updates subjective longevity beliefs, whereas financial literacy increases risky-asset participation by attenuating the deterrent effect of participation costs. We then build a heterogeneous-agent life-cycle model to evaluate survey-informed, revenue-neutral policy interventions. The counterfactuals show that financial literacy is the main driver of market entry, while survival literacy is complementary to financial literacy in raising the share of wealth invested in risky assets; only survival literacy, however, delivers positive welfare gains once financing costs are taken into account.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了主观生存信念与金融素养如何共同影响晚年储蓄及投资组合决策。利用英国老龄化纵向研究数据，我们发现低估自身生存概率的个体参与风险金融市场的可能性较低。为识别潜在机制，我们开展了一项随机调查实验，该实验交叉随机化生存干预与金融素养干预，并独立随机化参与成本。生存素养更新了主观寿命预期，而金融素养通过削弱参与成本的阻碍效应来提高风险资产参与度。随后，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，以评估基于调查信息且收入中性的政策干预。反事实分析表明，金融素养是市场进入的主要驱动力，而生存素养在提高风险资产财富占比方面对金融素养具有互补作用；然而，仅生存素养在考虑融资成本后能带来正向福利收益。
title: Survival and Financial Literacy in Investment Decisions Later in Life
title_zh: 晚年投资决策中的生存与金融素养

abstract: Job mobility is risky, workers are risk averse, and insurance markets are incomplete. This paper studies how these features curb and distort job-to-job transitions by making workers excessively cautious: they place too much weight on job safety over wage and productivity gains. We demonstrate this tradeoff by eliciting employed workers’ wage-safety indifference curves in a custom, representative survey. On average, employed US workers require a 1.63% pay raise to accept each additional percentage point of annual unemployment risk in a new job. We assess the macroeconomic consequences of our mechanism by embedding it into a general equilibrium search model. Jobs differ in both wages (productivity) and unemployment risk, and risk-averse workers self-insure against unemployment risk through a non-state-contingent bond while searching on and off the job. We find that a complete markets counterfactual would boost job mobility by 12% and productivity by 0.19%. We also highlight a new role for unemployment insurance: it encourages employed workers to accept risky but high-productivity offers, thereby increasing productivity (by 1.3%) and job creation—as well as job loss and unemployment.
abstract_zh: 工作流动性具有风险，工人是风险规避的，且保险市场不完善。本文研究这些特征如何通过使工人过度谨慎来抑制和扭曲工作间转换：他们过分重视工作安全性，而忽视工资和生产率收益。我们通过一项定制、具有代表性的调查，引出在职工人的工资-安全性无差异曲线，从而展示这一权衡。平均而言，美国在职工人要求每增加一个百分点的新工作年度失业风险，需获得1.63%的加薪作为补偿。我们通过将该机制嵌入一般均衡搜索模型来评估其宏观经济后果。工作不仅在工资（生产率）上存在差异，也在失业风险上有所不同，风险规避的工人通过非状态依赖债券进行自我保险，同时在职或离职状态下进行搜索。我们发现，一个完全市场的反事实情景将使工作流动性提高12%，生产率提高0.19%。我们还强调了失业保险的新作用：它鼓励在职工人接受风险高但生产率高的职位，从而提高生产率（1.3%）和就业创造——同时也增加了失业和失业率。
title: Cautious Careers: Job Mobility under Incomplete Markets
title_zh: 谨慎的职业路径：不完全市场下的工作流动性

abstract: Protected areas play a central role in territorial governance and the provision of environmental public goods, yet their performance is typically evaluated through effectiveness-based frameworks rather than through efficiency analysis. This study provides a multidimensional assessment of 27 Italian National Parks, conceptualized as multi-mission public organizations operating within complex territorial and institutional contexts. Four mission-specific domains - ecological performance, tourism valorization, managerial administration, and governance capacity - are evaluated using Data Envelopment Analysis within a non-radial framework that captures asymmetric inefficiencies across functions. The analysis explicitly examines the role of institutional scale, distinguishing between pure technical inefficiency and structural scale effects. Results reveal differentiated performance regimes: ecological outcomes are largely anchored in territorial endowment, whereas tourism and managerial domains exhibit both slack-driven and scale-related inefficiencies. Governance performance appears strongly conditioned by the configuration of institutional scales. These findings highlight the importance of scale alignment and mission-specific benchmarking for improving the design and coordination of protected-area governance systems.
abstract_zh: 保护区在领土治理和环境公共产品供给中发挥着核心作用，然而其绩效通常通过基于有效性的框架而非效率分析来评估。本研究对27个意大利国家公园进行了多维度评估，将其概念化为在复杂领土和制度背景下运作的多使命公共组织。四个特定使命领域——生态绩效、旅游增值、管理行政和治理能力——采用数据包络分析在非径向框架内进行评估，该框架能够捕捉各功能间的非对称低效率。分析明确考察了制度规模的作用，区分了纯技术低效率与结构性规模效应。结果显示差异化的绩效模式：生态成果主要锚定于领土禀赋，而旅游和管理领域则表现出由松弛驱动和规模相关的双重低效率。治理绩效似乎受到制度规模配置的强烈制约。这些发现凸显了规模匹配和使命特定基准对于改善保护区治理体系设计与协调的重要性。
title: Multidimensional efficiency and institutional scale heterogeneity in protected areas: Evidence from Italy
title_zh: 保护区多维效率与制度规模异质性：来自意大利的证据

abstract: In this paper, we revisit the setup proposed in Nowak and Sigmund (1998) (NS (1998) henceforth) to study the evolution of social norms when individuals experience forms of indirect reciprocity based on the reputation of agents in the population. A result of the framework in NS (1998) is that cooperative behavior connected to the first-order assessment of reputations does not survive in the long run. Cooperators are always victims of a mutation in the population that favors free-riding. We extend the setup in NS (1998) studying the discrete-time dynamics of the evolution of social norms and introducing an additional form of social sanctioning: individuals who are naturally inclined to act pro-socially may act as enforcers (as in Sethi and Somanathan, 1996) and report free-riders to a third-party authority, which may impose a fine. We show, mainly numerically, that the conduct of enforcers, together with the presence of indirect reciprocity, allows for the existence of equilibria in which cooperation survives, and cooperative agents can co-exist with free-riders in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nowak和Sigmund（1998）（以下简称NS（1998））提出的框架，用以研究当个体经历基于群体中代理人声誉的间接互惠形式时，社会规范的演化。NS（1998）框架的一个结果是，与一阶声誉评估相关的合作行为在长期中无法存续。合作者总是成为群体中偏好搭便车的突变的受害者。我们扩展了NS（1998）的设置，研究社会规范演化的离散时间动态，并引入一种额外的社会制裁形式：天生倾向于亲社会行为的个体可能充当执行者（如Sethi和Somanathan，1996），向第三方权威举报搭便车者，该权威可施加罚款。我们主要通过数值方法表明，执行者的行为，连同间接互惠的存在，使得合作得以存续的均衡得以存在，且合作者与搭便车者能够在长期中共存。
title: Discrete-time dynamics of indirect reciprocity: The role of punishment
title_zh: 间接互惠的离散时间动态：惩罚的作用

abstract: The political economy setting of voting over general nonlinear income taxes with labor disincentives and information asymmetry in consumer/worker/voter types is considered. Agents do not communicate or coordinate with each other. The economy is the realization of a finite draw from a continuous distribution. The revenue required from a draw is determined by Pareto optimal provision of a public good for that draw. Assuming that the government must meet the revenue requirement for any possible draw, in other words the tax is robust, a majority rule equilibrium is shown to exist at the median voter’s preferred tax function out of this robust set. The key restrictions on utility are additive separability, quasi-linearity, and that utility from the public good is multiplicative in type. JEL numbers: D72, D82, H21, H41 Keywords: Voting; Income taxation; Public good; Robustness
abstract_zh: 本文考虑了在一般非线性所得税上进行投票的政治经济环境，其中包含劳动抑制因素以及消费者/工人/选民类型的信息不对称。各主体之间不进行沟通或协调。经济状态是连续分布中有限次抽取的实现结果。每次抽取所需的财政收入由该抽取下公共物品的帕累托最优供给决定。假设政府必须满足任何可能抽取下的财政收入要求，即税收具有稳健性，则证明在多数规则均衡下，存在中位选民在该稳健集合中最偏好的税收函数。对效用的关键限制包括可加可分性、拟线性，以及公共物品效用与类型呈乘性关系。JEL分类号：D72, D82, H21, H41 关键词：投票；所得税；公共物品；稳健性
title: On the Political Economy of Nonlinear Income Taxation
title_zh: 论非线性所得税的政治经济学

abstract: China is the world’s second-largest economy, and its monetary policy can affect global demand and trade. Using granular mutual fund data, this column finds that country stock indices and firm-level stocks with greater exposure to Chinese mutual funds experience significantly lower returns than those with less exposure following contractionary Chinese monetary policy announcements. These responses can be explained by a portfolio rebalancing channel and appear to be driven by retail investors. Overall, the findings show that China’s private portfolio equity flows already exert an influence on global equity markets, and this channel is likely to strengthen in the future.
abstract_zh: 中国作为全球第二大经济体，其货币政策能够影响全球需求与贸易。利用细粒度共同基金数据，本专栏发现，在中国紧缩性货币政策公告后，相较于敞口较小的国家股指和公司层面股票，那些对中国共同基金敞口较大的股票指数及个股回报率显著更低。这些反应可通过投资组合再平衡渠道解释，且似乎主要由散户投资者驱动。总体而言，研究结果表明，中国的私人投资组合股权流动已对全球股票市场产生影响，且这一渠道未来可能进一步加强。
authors: Chang Ma, Alessandro Rebucci, Sili Zhou
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: A nascent international financial channel of China’s monetary policy transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道

abstract: We study how poorly-behaved children affect learning and other outcomes of their peers using data from a unique experiment in Ecuador. Within each school, students were randomly assigned to classrooms in every grade for seven consecutive grades, between kindergarten and 6th grade. Children with persistent behavioral problems lower the math and language achievement of their classmates. The more poorly-behaved children there are in a class, the larger is the negative effect on the achievement of their classmates. These negative impacts are larger for younger children, and they persist for at least two years after exposure to a poorly-behaved peer.
abstract_zh: 我们利用厄瓜多尔一项独特实验的数据，研究了行为不良儿童如何影响其同伴的学习及其他成果。在每所学校内，从幼儿园至六年级连续七个年级，学生被随机分配到各年级的教室中。具有持续行为问题的儿童会降低同班同学的数学和语言成绩。班级中行为不良儿童的数量越多，对同班同学成绩的负面影响就越大。这些负面影响对年龄较小的儿童更为显著，并且在接触行为不良同伴后至少持续两年。
title: Disruption in the Classroom: Experimental Evidence from Ecuador
title_zh: 课堂中的干扰：来自厄瓜多尔的实验证据

abstract: We develop a sovereign default model with debt renegotiation in which interest-rate shocks affect default incentives through two mechanisms. Under the standard mechanism, higher interest rates tighten the government’s budget constraint. Under the renegotiation mechanism, higher rates increase lenders’ opportunity cost of holding delinquent debt, which makes lenders accept larger haircuts and makes default more attractive for the government. We argue that our novel renegotiation mechanism reconciles standard sovereign default models with the narrative that the sharp increase in the real interest rate in the United States was a relevant factor in the defaults of the early 1980s.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含债务重议的主权违约模型，其中利率冲击通过两种机制影响违约激励。在标准机制下，较高的利率收紧政府的预算约束。在重议机制下，较高的利率增加了贷款方持有违约债务的机会成本，这促使贷款方接受更大的减记，并使政府违约更具吸引力。我们认为，我们提出的新颖重议机制调和了标准主权违约模型与关于20世纪80年代初美国实际利率急剧上升是违约重要因素的叙述。
title: Default and Interest Rate Shocks: Renegotiation Matters
title_zh: 违约与利率冲击：再谈判至关重要

abstract: We develop a tractable sticky price model in which the fraction of price changes evolves endogenously over time and, consistent with the evidence, increases with inflation. Because we assume that firms sell multiple products and choose how many, but not which, prices to adjust in every period, our model admits exact aggregation and reduces to a one-equation extension of the Calvo model. The model features a powerful inflation accelerator–a feedback loop between inflation and the fraction of price changes–which significantly increases the slope of the Phillips curve during periods of high inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个易于处理的粘性价格模型，其中价格变动的比例随时间内生演变，并且与实证证据一致，随通胀上升而增加。由于我们假设企业销售多种产品，并在每期选择调整多少价格而非哪些价格，我们的模型实现了精确加总，并简化为卡尔沃模型的一个单方程扩展。该模型具有强大的通胀加速器效应——通胀与价格变动比例之间的反馈循环——这在高通胀时期显著增大了菲利普斯曲线的斜率。
title: The Inflation Accelerator
title_zh: 通货膨胀加速器
